user.title: i3X
user.description: Expose Home Assistant as an i3X server, or connect to an external i3X server.

menu_options.server: Expose Home Assistant as an i3X server

server.title: i3X Server
server.description: Expose Home Assistant as a CESMII i3X 1.0 server at /api/i3x/v1. All endpoints except /info require a Home Assistant access token.

data.server_name: Server name (shown on the unauthenticated /info endpoint)
data.local_only: Only accept requests from the local network
data.write_enabled: Allow value-changing writes (echo/no-op writes are always accepted)
data.write_entity_globs: Writable entity globs (allowlist for value-changing writes)

client.title: i3X Client
client.description: Connect to an external CESMII i3X 1.0 server. Enter the versioned base URL, e.g. https://host/i3x/v1.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the i3X server. Check the base URL.
error.invalid_auth: The i3X server rejected the credentials.
error.auth_incomplete: Fill in the credentials matching the chosen authentication type.

abort.already_configured: This i3X server or connection is already configured. Adjust it via the integration's options.

data.server_name: Server name (shown on the unauthenticated /info endpoint)
data.local_only: Only accept requests from the local network
data.write_enabled: Allow value-changing writes (echo/no-op writes are always accepted)
data.write_entity_globs: Writable entity globs (allowlist for value-changing writes)
data.live_element_ids: Remote elementIds to surface as sensors
data.import_element_ids: Remote elementIds to import as measurement statistics
data.import_counter_element_ids: Remote elementIds to import as counter statistics

write.name: Write value
write.description: Writes a value to an object on a connected i3X server.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value to write (scalar or structured object).

quality.name: Quality
quality.description: VQT quality; defaults to Good on the server.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: VQT timestamp; defaults to the server's time.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which i3X client connection to write through (defaults to the first loaded one).
